## Design

| [0055](0055-standing-decisions.md) | Standing decisions | accepted | complete | — | A-157 | The standing baseline for this repository after RFC 0053's archive: the rows that govern the tree as it is, drafted through the brownfield lane from the survey, the gate record and the archive, for the owner to grade and accept. |
